content.content:
1. Necessity: the prerequisites fix where a draft's workspace lives, what one opening call does over its argument list, how a call naming no node is answered, and the registry's record form with its states, references and content-identity base. None of them is a model of the opening action, so it is unsettled whether a machine holds one opening call's effect at once: how many records the call writes and for which named nodes, what base each record carries, which workspace each draft is given, and whether a call naming no node has already refused before any record or workspace exists. Fail if the model artifact could be dropped without loss.

2. Fidelity, both directions, applied to the model the dependent's content refs, read against each prerequisite as each is recorded at check time:

a. No looser — every fact a prerequisite fixes about opening is carried by the model: that one opening call acts on a list of names and writes exactly one record per name in it, none skipped and none written twice, and that each such write is a key-inserting write into the registry the action starts from — filing a record under a handle the registry does not yet hold inserts that key, so the action steps on a fresh, empty registry; a write that only assigns at a key the registry must already hold (in Quint, Map::set on an absent key) files no record on a fresh registry and so does not carry the fact that the call writes records, while a key-inserting write (Map::put on an absent key) does, and the finding names the operator and the line of the record write; that each record so written is in the state the registry fixes as the first; that each record carries a content-identity base determined by the owned content at the moment of opening; that each draft's workspace is its own, distinct per record, carried by the record through the reference the record form fixes; and that a call naming no node is refused at the argument surface with no record and no workspace after it. A fact the model omits, weakens or leaves unconstrained is a loose divergence: name the fact and the prerequisite that fixes it.

b. No stricter — the model requires, forbids or constrains nothing a prerequisite does not fix: no step or guard for a call the surface does not admit, no record element, state or reference beyond the ones the record form fixes, no second workspace for one record, no refusal of an argument the surface does not refuse, no ordering or atomicity rule the prerequisites do not state, and no graph effect of its own (no node, edit or marker written by opening). Any such element is a strict divergence: name it and the rule it adds.

c. Where a prerequisite carries a machine-checkable artifact that fixes a shape the opening action uses — the registry's record document, its states and its references — the opening model is read against that artifact field by field and value by value: a fact the artifact fixes and the model contradicts, omits or weakens, and a fact the model adds that the artifact does not fix, are divergences, each named in the direction it falls. That shape is the artifact's, read at check time; it is not restated here.

The criterion names no element of the model or of the dependencies in advance: which fact is at issue, and which operator and line carry it, is found while reading the artifact against the recorded prerequisites, and appears only in the finding. It tracks no wording of the dependent and survives a rewording of the dependent that leaves what it decides unchanged.
content.rationale:
Four edges claim one opening action. The dependent is a Quint module — a tool-checkable artifact — so the edges sit on the fidelity cells: the three requirement sentences (the workspace's place, the surface behaviour of one call over its argument list, the refusal of a call naming no node) are natural-to-code, and the registry model is code-to-code. The check is necessity plus fidelity: the model must enforce exactly the opening the prerequisites fix, neither looser nor stricter. That is the right gate because the model must enforce exactly that, and because a record the step cannot file is itself a loose divergence: a well-typed model can still open two records for one name, lose the base, share one workspace across drafts, let the empty call reach a state change, or file with a write that requires a key the registry does not yet hold — the last showing only when the action is stepped from the registry's empty initial map — and each diverges in one direction a one-directional check would miss.

This gate was amended to add the executability of the record write to the no-looser direction. The old criterion read the model's shape and could count one filing per name without asking whether the filing can run: a fold that assigns at a key the registry must already hold still reads as one record per name and yet files none from the registry's empty initial state, so it does not carry the fact that a call writes records. The added fact is the executable side of the same prerequisite fact — each name gets a record the action actually writes — and it pins no implementation: the reviewer reads the operator at the record write against the registry the action starts from, and the finding names the operator and the line when that write requires an absent key. Every other fact and every exclusion of the criterion is unchanged.

It is applied by reading the model against each prerequisite as recorded at check time, so it reads whatever the prerequisites land and pins none of their wording: the three requirement sentences and the registry model are skeletons in this layer and are read as each lands, and the criterion presupposes no clause their final text must contain. The record's field set, its state values and its references are the registry artifact's, read at check time rather than pre-authored here.

One evaluation covers all four edges because they claim one act from four sides and a single pass over the model answers all four; splitting would read the same artifact four times. Nothing stands as a separate test path: a Quint typecheck of the model is only the precondition that the artifact parses, and the review is the gate — in this form red is the artifact's absence, the prerequisites' opening form unenforced until the model exists, and, once it exists, any fact of the criterion it does not carry, including a record write that cannot step from the registry's empty initial map. A throwaway `quint run` of the action over that initial registry, made in a copy outside the repository and outside this unit's write set, is evidence the reviewer may use for the write's executability, not a check path this evaluation adds. The code-to-code edge's cell asks for a runnable check; this unit's write set licenses no check path beyond the evaluation node and the model itself, so that edge is read as a field-by-field comparison plus the write's executability under a run, and the cell is flagged for a matrix entry.
